result.title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
result.comment: Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026). Project page: https://ultratex.vercel.app/
result.summary: Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 UltraTex，一个级联多视角扩散框架，从单张参考图为 3D 网格生成 PBR 贴图：先联合预测 albedo 与世界空间着色法线，再以 albedo、参考图和材质语义先验为条件估计金属度-粗糙度，并借助 VLM 隐层特征适配器与光度表示对齐注入物理知识。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属 3D 材质生成，不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成，但其将扩散中间特征对齐到受控光照下的真实材质渲染、并把 VLM 隐层特征作为语义锚点，可能为 LVR 的中层表示监督与视觉证据锚定提供可供核查的线索。
